-- Query 1: Order Composition Analysis (Summary of the revenue generated by Package, Sets, and individual Items)

-- ENABLE FORMATTING
CL SCR;
SET SQLBLANKLINES ON;
SET SERVEROUTPUT ON;

-- Create View for all 3 categories

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW vw_OrderComposition AS

SELECT 'Individual Item' AS SourceCategory,
        I.ItemName AS ProductName,
        OI.Quantity AS TotalSold,
        (OI.Quantity * OI.PriceEach) AS Revenue
FROM    ORDERITEM OI
JOIN    ITEM I ON OI.ItemID = I.ItemID
JOIN    ORDERS O ON OI.OrderID = O.OrderID
WHERE   OI.ItemSetID IS NULL
AND     O.OrderStatus = 'Completed'

UNION ALL

SELECT 'Set Item' AS SourceCategory,
        S.SetName AS ProductName,
        OI.Quantity AS TotalSold,
        (OI.Quantity * OI.PriceEach - S.Discount) AS Revenue
FROM    ORDERITEM OI
JOIN    ITEMSET S ON OI.ItemSetID = S.ItemSetID
JOIN    ORDERS O ON OI.OrderID = O.OrderID
WHERE   OI.ItemSetID IS NOT NULL
AND     O.OrderStatus = 'Completed'

UNION ALL

SELECT 'Package Item' AS SourceCategory,
        P.PackageName AS ProductName,
        OP.Quantity AS TotalSold,
        OP.Subtotal AS Revenue
FROM    ORDERPACKAGE OP
JOIN    PACKAGE P ON OP.PackageID = P.PackageID
JOIN    ORDERS O ON OP.OrderID = O.OrderID
WHERE   O.OrderStatus = 'Completed';

CL SCR;

-- Display results

SET LINESIZE 100
SET FEEDBACK OFF

COLUMN COMPOSITION_TYPE FORMAT A25 HEADING 'COMPOSITION TYPE'   JUSTIFY LEFT
COLUMN TOTAL_QTY_SOLD   FORMAT A14 HEADING 'TOTAL QTY SOLD'     JUSTIFY RIGHT
COLUMN TOTAL_REVENUE    FORMAT A20 HEADING 'TOTAL REVENUE (RM)' JUSTIFY RIGHT
COLUMN CONTRIBUTION_PCT FORMAT A16 HEADING 'CONTRIBUTION (%)'   JUSTIFY RIGHT

TTITLE LEFT '==============================================================================' SKIP 1 -
       LEFT '                          ORDER COMPOSITION ANALYSIS                          ' SKIP 1 -
       LEFT '==============================================================================' SKIP 1

SELECT COMPOSITION_TYPE, TOTAL_QTY_SOLD, TOTAL_REVENUE, CONTRIBUTION_PCT
FROM (
    SELECT  SourceCategory AS COMPOSITION_TYPE,
            LPAD(TRIM(TO_CHAR(SUM(TotalSold), '999,990')), 14) AS TOTAL_QTY_SOLD,
            LPAD(TRIM(TO_CHAR(SUM(Revenue), '$999,990.99')), 20) AS TOTAL_REVENUE,
            LPAD(TRIM(TO_CHAR(ROUND(RATIO_TO_REPORT(SUM(Revenue)) OVER () * 100, 2), '990.00')), 16) AS CONTRIBUTION_PCT,
            1 AS SortOrder,
            SUM(Revenue) AS SortRev
    FROM    vw_OrderComposition
    GROUP BY SourceCategory

    UNION ALL

    SELECT  '-------------------------' AS COMPOSITION_TYPE,
            '--------------' AS TOTAL_QTY_SOLD,
            '--------------------' AS TOTAL_REVENUE,
            '----------------' AS CONTRIBUTION_PCT,
            2 AS SortOrder,
            0 AS SortRev
    FROM    DUAL

    UNION ALL

    SELECT  'GRAND TOTAL :' AS COMPOSITION_TYPE,
            LPAD(TRIM(TO_CHAR(SUM(TotalSold), '999,990')), 14) AS TOTAL_QTY_SOLD,
            LPAD(TRIM(TO_CHAR(SUM(Revenue), '$999,990.99')), 20) AS TOTAL_REVENUE,
            LPAD('100.00', 16) AS CONTRIBUTION_PCT,
            3 AS SortOrder,
            0 AS SortRev
    FROM    vw_OrderComposition
)
ORDER BY SortOrder ASC, SortRev DESC;

TTITLE OFF
SET HEADING OFF

DECLARE
  v_TopCategory   VARCHAR2(50);
  v_TopRevenue    NUMBER(11,2);
  v_TopPercentage NUMBER(5,2);
BEGIN
  SELECT SourceCategory, TotalCategoryRevenue, ContributionPct
  INTO v_TopCategory, v_TopRevenue, v_TopPercentage
  FROM (
    SELECT SourceCategory,
           SUM(Revenue) AS TotalCategoryRevenue,
           ROUND(RATIO_TO_REPORT(SUM(Revenue)) OVER () * 100, 2) AS ContributionPct
    FROM vw_OrderComposition
    GROUP BY SourceCategory
    ORDER BY TotalCategoryRevenue DESC
  )
  WHERE ROWNUM = 1;

  DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('------------------------------------------------------------------------------');
  DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('[ EXECUTIVE SUMMARY ]');
  DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('>> HIGHEST CONTRIBUTOR : ' || INITCAP(v_TopCategory));
  DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('>> TOTAL GENERATED     : RM ' || TRIM(TO_CHAR(v_TopRevenue, '999,990.99')) || ' (' || v_TopPercentage || '% of Total Revenue)');
  DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('==============================================================================');

EXCEPTION
  WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('ERROR: No sales data found.');
  WHEN OTHERS THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('AN UNEXPECTED ERROR OCCURRED: ' || SQLERRM);
END;
/

SET HEADING ON
SET FEEDBACK ON
CLEAR COLUMNS
